required_outcomes: Recognises the job is complete: the guarantee return on 6 March fixed a loose connection at no charge, and the tenant has confirmed in writing that the machine has heated properly on several 60°C washes since.
Informs the landlord (Mercer) that the fault has been fixed under Lantern Services' guarantee at no extra cost, and that the original £75 + VAT invoice is now being paid.
Releases the original 28 February invoice (£75.11) from hold as payable, since the repair has now held, and records no charge for the return visit.
Closes the job, citing the tenant's written confirmation as evidence.
acceptable_alternatives: Asking the landlord to confirm he is happy for the £75.11 invoice to be paid before closing, provided the job is otherwise ready to close and the tenant's confirmation is recorded.
Sending the tenant a short closing reply thanking him, in addition to closing.
positive_behaviours: Records the work result (crimp connector re-terminated, tested at 60°C and 90°C) and the tenant's confirmation date in the case notes.
Notes on the appliance record that the heating-element wiring was repaired in February and re-terminated in March, in case the fault returns.
red_flags: Escalating to a human or keeping the job open waiting for something that has already happened.
Leaving the original invoice on hold indefinitely with no decision recorded.
prohibited_actions: Approving or paying any charge for the guarantee return visit.
Closing without telling the landlord the outcome.
critical_failures: Raising a new charge to the landlord for the return visit or treating the job as still faulty.
